caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a leather shoulder bag. The bag is tan or light brown in color, with soft, rounded edges and a curved flap that folds over the front. There are two dark rings connecting the bag to the shoulder strap, one on each side. The strap is long, relatively wide, and depicted as a reddish-brown color with shading to convey depth. The strap is looped and shows metal buckles for adjustment on either side near the rings. There is a small, simple closure or button on the flap of the bag and three stitched or indented marks visible on the main body of the bag. The background is plain and uncolored, highlighting the bag as the sole subject. The name "Ethel Dougan" and the year "1938" are written in the bottom right corner.
title: Ammunition Bag
